Hi Evan 

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Auriga's search and triage workflow. Quick recap from my side and a proposed set of next steps so engineering and procurement can see what an evaluation would look like.

Recap
- Current pain: high per-query cost and spike latency during peak batch processing (nightly ingestion).
- What you showed: on-prem search service + custom reranker; ~2M queries/day during peak.
- Goal: reduce per-query cost by ~40% while keeping p95 latency under 300ms for customer-facing queries.

What Redwood can do (high level)
- Dedicated inference pool with autoscaling to keep p95 latency predictable.
- Intelligent caching + prefix caching to reduce token usage on repeat queries.
- Quantization profile options and batching to improve unit economics for long-form reranking.

Proposed next steps
1) Share the one-pager + mutual action plan (attached) for internal review.
2) 30-min technical deep-dive with your platform/infra lead  propose Wed or Thu next week.
3) Provide a quick cost estimate for a 30-day pilot based on the numbers you shared (I asked for sample traffic and we'll run a back-of-envelope).

Ask: could you send the contact for the platform lead and the approximate sample traffic file (or a sanitized example)? If timing changed on your side, tell me and we can shift the cadence.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan-auriga.xlsx

Thanks  looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
